review_notes: I read the whole file against the rubric. Its definitions are tartarAmplitudeSecondDerivativeIntegrand, tartarAmplitudeSecondDerivative, tartarTestFunctionSecondDerivativeBound, tartarTestFunctionSecondDerivative, poitouKernelDerivative, poitouVerticalProfileDerivative, regularizedPoitouVerticalProfile, poitouKernelSecondDerivative, poitouVerticalProfileSecondDerivative and regularizedScaledTartarSecondDerivative. Each is an explicit closed-form expression for a derivative of a project-specific object (the Tartar amplitude and test function, or the Poitou kernel and its profile). The file proves HasDerivAt lemmas that link each one to `deriv`, and uses the closed forms to get explicit decay bounds. They do not compete with a Mathlib concept. `iteratedDeriv` is the nearest Mathlib notion, and it does not provide the explicit formulas or the bounds. I did not find a Mathlib definition with the same meaning as any of them. The only close match to an existing Mathlib result is `abs_sinh_le_cosh`, which is a standalone theorem, and the rubric excludes those. I did not search Mathlib for it. I found no case for consolidation, so I abstain.
